counting_law: PB2 E-Law 8. Identities = unique executable configurations on the scored line. The C2 battery is ONE identity; its <=128 seed sub-runs run on their OWN ledger line and are NOT scored rows, but they DO count toward the multiple-testing and compute denominators (disclosed per line). B0 = 1 identity, 0 rows (PB2 §1). Stress and leave-one-* re-runs are identity-classified.
dedup_key_law: Each arm's dedup key = (engine code SHA, arm config digest, selection/learned-parameter digest, cost tier, fold contract). Config digests exist only at FREEZE-2; until then arms are identified by their symbolic composition below. Two rows with identical dedup keys are ONE arm (byte-identical degeneracies collapsed by construction, not by omission).
canonical_resolutions: LOL is declared over ADMITTED legs only. GBPUSD-S017 is retired at registration (owner election), so no LOL/S017 arm exists; its two-sided contrast is carried by LORO(G1). This is the canonical law — the v2 '12 LOL incl. S017' table is superseded (alternatives in ERRATUM_V3 appendix).
LORO(J3) is realized as the guard-IN arm (SLATE+guard at the FREEZE-2 multiplier) because the canonical SLATE ships with the guard REMOVED (default node). Not a degeneracy — a distinct configuration.
C2 fold rows are counted INSIDE the scored-row budget (stricter RULE_SLATE convention). The DAILY convention (outside) is an appendix alternative only.
x2.0 stress arms are identity-classified (RULE_SLATE/E-Law 8). The DAILY rows-only convention is an appendix alternative only.

Reserve (3 identities) is for TECHNICAL re-runs only (TECHABORT twins, integrity re-runs) — it may NOT carry new hypotheses after FREEZE-2 and may not be used to search for positive PnL. Headroom (caps minus committed) is not spendable without a registered amendment before FREEZE-2.
Selection is deterministic TRAIN-only (LEARN-side); tie-breaks frozen at FREEZE-1; no post-hoc node substitution.

ROUND-4 NOTE (config uniqueness): verify_arm_manifest.py sums SYMBOLIC arm IDs — it does not prove configuration uniqueness. Config-digest uniqueness is established only at FREEZE-2 by the exact-arm dry-run (PC12A law): if FREEZE-2 selects the J3 node = REMOVED (infinity), the guard-IN arm's config collapses to SLATE's and the crossed arms collapse to LOL-no-S003/no-S023 configs — byte-identical duplicates must be DETECTED, typed as degeneracies, and NOT executed twice; the prelaunch spec must include this identity check and may not add post-freeze arms.

ROUND-4 NOTE (B1S scope + comparator): B1S is same-ADMITTED-legs (S017 retired at registration) — it measures the hygiene rules on the admitted set ONLY and does NOT measure the retirement's value vs the original 12-leg always-on book. That comparison is OUT of this battery's scope and belongs to the exploratory replay program (EXPLORATORY_REPLAY_LAUNCH_DRAFT, which carries B1_ORIG12 as a comparator identity).

ROUND-4 NOTE (stress path-invariance): static re-pricing at tiers x1.5/x2.0 assumes PATH INVARIANCE (identical fills, re-priced costs). Any arm whose rules key to cost-dependent state (e.g. a spend-capped guard) changes its trade path under stress and requires a FULL re-run, not a re-price; the prelaunch spec must declare, per arm, whether stress is re-price (path-invariant) or re-run (path-dependent).
